strongest_angle: Geological findings published in November 2026 reveal that an ancient failed rift inside the Kalahari Craton in eastern Botswana is reawakening following a magnitude 6.5 earthquake in April 2017.

key_facts.fact: In April 2017, a magnitude 6.5 earthquake shook southern Africa from the middle of the Kalahari Craton in eastern Botswana.
The Kalahari Craton is built from blocks of crust up to 3.7 billion years old in eastern Botswana.
A new study published in November 2026 was led by researchers at the Botswana International University of Science and Technology and the Lamont-Doherty Earth Observatory.
